items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: They had Duke Drew Pearson (PHONETIC), big band over there on Monday nights or either Clark Terry and his big band on Monday night.

ctx.x: The part I was in, that was up in his apartment, just he and I. We didn't play no tunes or nothing. He would just run over his horn and I'd pull a few notes. But we got paid for it.

After that, I went into Minton's with Blue Mitchell and [unintelligible] that, I went down to see Elvin Jones. I hadn't seen him since I'd been back in New York. He was working down on Hudson Street in a little place called Pookie's Pub (PHONETIC). It was across the street from the Half Note. The Half Note is kind of famous. This is on, say, like Monday night. Blue worked the weekends.
